## Summary

Describe the product behavior and why the change is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Core logic tests and cross-platform CI are green
- [ ] Shipped-file impact and release eligibility reviewed
- [ ] Autodesk Fusion acceptance performed where relevant (state OS/version), or explicitly not yet tested
- [ ] EN/RU documentation and screenshots updated when user-facing
- [ ] No secrets, customer CAD models, regenerated UUIDs or accidental breaking changes
